newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post business - Oct 11.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post business - Oct 11.

text.p: The Washington Post carried the following items on the front page of its business section on Friday:

NEW YORK - In the first stage of a massive federal probe into secret, illegal payments made to stock brokers, 45 people were charged with inducing brokers to buy stock for their clients in companies whose shares were being manipulated.
WASHINGTON - Ford Motor Co, pressured by Japanese rivals, is reorganising key parts and vehicle development operations to cut production costs and prices of new cars and trucks.
WASHINGTON - Microsoft Corp unveiled a new version of the Microsoft Network, this time tying it intimately to the Internet.
WASHINGTON - Renee Henry illustrates changing times at the Kenilworth-Parkside complex in northeast Washington, a project that has been a laboratory for new public housing concepts.
